facts.claim: At their closest points, the two Diomede islands are about 2.4 miles away from each other.
Big Diomede is 21 hours ahead of Little Diomede due to locally defined time zones and the International Date Line.
Little Diomede Island is located about 16 miles west of mainland Alaska.
